notes: Gameplay run-bed candidates guided by the Ballance sound pack the project already carries (src/renderer/assets/audio/dont_modify/ is the full 40-file rip). Build the reference blends first: build-ambience-reference-mix.py --list run-bed-references-ballance-music.txt --seconds-per-source 6 --out reference-audio/Ballance_music_mix.wav and --list run-bed-references-ballance-all.txt --seconds-per-source 1.5 --out reference-audio/Ballance_all_mix.wav. Render with `yarn audio:ace-step:run-bed`, score with pick-ace-takes.py, cut the winner with make-seamless-loop.py into src/renderer/assets/audio/music/run-loop.wav. Reference audio guides style only; the Ballance files themselves are never shipped as music (see RIGHTS.md).
